    omega = pole.angularVelocity  # True angular velocity
    x = sandbox.get_cart_position()  # True cart position

    target_x = sandbox.TRACK_CENTER_X  # Correct track center

    # Control gains (adjusted for stability and responsiveness)
    K_theta = 100.0  # Angle control
    K_omega = 20.0   # Angular velocity control
    K_p = 1.0        # Position error control
    K_v = 0.5        # Velocity control

    # Compute the control force
    force = -K_theta * theta - K_omega * omega - K_p * (x - target_x) - K_v * v

    # Apply the force within the actuator limits
    lim = 450.0
    sandbox.apply_cart_force(max(-lim, min(lim, force)))
